lines: Projectiles of one cast may all strike the same target
new.name: Stormstaff

lines: Projectiles of one cast may all strike the same target
new.name: Staff of Fracturing

lines: Projectiles of one cast may all strike the same target
new.name: Dundr

lines: Adds a random lightning property to an item, up to its best tier, or one of Eikthyr's own
old.name: Essence of Eikthyr

lines: Randomises the numeric values of modifiers on an item. An item from an older version becomes current: its outdated modifiers are replaced with today's.
new.name: Great Rune of Fate

lines: Randomises the numeric values of modifiers on an item
old.name: Great Rune of Fate

lines: Offer at an altar of summoning or a boss altar: the next boss rises with one more star (up to five)
new.name: Rune of the Blood Challenge

lines: Offer at an altar of summoning: the next guardian rises with one more star (up to five)
old.name: Rune of the Blood Challenge

lines: Increases damage over time from bleeding, burning and poison, separately from the damage of the hit that caused them. It does not affect chill. Old shock-damage bonuses now act as shock effect.
new.name: Ailment damage

lines: Increases damage over time from bleeding, burning and poison. It does not affect chill or shock, which deal no health damage.
old.name: Ailment damage

lines: Slash damage fills the bleeding gauge. When it fills, bleeding deals 20% of the slash damage of the strongest hit in the build-up per second for 4 s, over time and through armour. Bleeding damage, the damage over time multiplier and duration change it separately. Each player keeps their own strongest bleed on a target; a weaker one does not refresh it.
new.name: Bleeding

lines: Slash damage fills the bleeding gauge. When applied, bleeding deals damage over time that bypasses armour; bleeding damage and duration modify the effect separately.
old.name: Bleeding

lines: Fire damage fills the burning gauge. When it fills, burning deals 25% of the fire damage of the strongest hit in the build-up per second for 4 s, as fire damage over time. Burning damage and the damage over time multiplier make it stronger, duration makes it last longer. Each player keeps their own strongest burn on a target; a weaker one does not refresh it. Wet shortens it, and chill removes it.
new.name: Burning

lines: Fire damage fills the burning gauge. Burning deals fire damage over time; a stronger burn replaces a weaker one, Wet shortens it, and chill removes it.
old.name: Burning

lines: Deals fire damage over time and builds burning through its explicit ailment channel. Spells create it when they hit terrain if you have the corresponding source. Identical overlapping ground does not stack.
new.name: Burning Ground

lines: Deals cold damage over time and builds chill. All grounded characters slide on it, including its creator and allies. Sliding changes traction and braking, not movement speed. Identical overlapping ground does not stack.
new.name: Chilled Ground

lines: Applicable general and typed damage over time multiplier bonuses add together and form one multiplier. +20% general and +15% fire give fire damage over time ×1.35. This is separate from increased damage and does not repeat the original hit's damage modifiers.
new.name: Damage over Time Multiplier

lines: Bow and crossbow shots deal full damage only up to their effective range, a little beyond melee distance. Further away the damage falls off with the distance to the target, down to a fifth at five times that distance. Increased effective range moves both distances further out.
new.name: Effective Range

lines: While your health is below the endurance threshold, the part of any incoming damage (hits and damage over time alike) that falls below it is reduced: 20% at base, at most 75%. The threshold is counted in health points. With Rune Bulwark the rune shield is checked instead of health.
new.name: Endurance

lines: While your health is below the endurance threshold, the part of each hit that falls below it is reduced: 20% at base, at most 75%. The threshold is counted in health points. With Rune Bulwark the rune shield is checked instead of health.
old.name: Endurance

lines: Evasion rating grants a chance to avoid a hit completely, including its damage, stagger, knockback and ailment. The chance weighs evasion rating against the attacker's accuracy and reaches 100% at 3 times the accuracy. Each evasion against the same attacker leaves 80% of the chance against it, until it lands no attack for 8 (30 for a boss). Each evasion costs 18% of maximum stamina; without that stamina the hit lands. Damage over time, persistent damaging ground and environmental damage cannot be evaded; a successful passive evasion triggers on evade, independently of a manual dodge roll.
new.name: Evasion rating

lines: Evasion rating grants a chance to avoid a hit completely, including its damage, stagger, knockback and ailment. The chance weighs evasion rating against the attacker's accuracy and is at most 75%; an accumulator smooths the sequence of hits and evasions. Damage over time, persistent damaging ground and environmental damage cannot be evaded; a successful passive evasion triggers on evade, independently of a manual dodge roll.
old.name: Evasion rating

lines: Ground effects occupy separate patches. Your base limit is 1 patch across all types; global skill limit and ground limit increase it. Each projectile can create a patch: three projectiles can leave three patches at limit 3. At the limit, a new patch replaces the oldest. Identical effects do not stack where they overlap. Ground damage is damage over time, not a hit or an aura.
new.name: Ground Effects

lines: Absorbing your ground with a staff shrinks the patch and accumulates matching infusion. The next eligible manually cast damaging spell consumes the stored infusion once. Its added damage is shared between the cast's projectiles and repeats; ordinary spell damage is not divided. Natural ground expiry grants no infusion. Absorption cannot repeatedly harvest overlapping area or recapture its own spent infusion for a net gain.
new.name: Infusion

lines: An elemental damage type that fills the shock gauge. A shocked target takes more damage and builds up stagger faster for a few seconds.
new.name: Lightning damage

lines: An elemental damage type that fills the shock gauge. Shock increases stagger build-up rather than dealing additional health damage.
old.name: Lightning damage

lines: Poison damage fills the poison gauge. When it fills, poison deals 15% of the poison damage of the strongest hit in the build-up per second for 4 s. Each player can keep up to 3 poisons on a target at once, and a poison limit raises that; a new poison on a full set replaces the weakest, if it is stronger. Poison damage and the damage over time multiplier make it stronger. Poison is separate from elemental damage.
new.name: Poison

lines: Poison damage fills the poison gauge. Poison deals damage over time; a stronger effect replaces a weaker one. Poison is separate from elemental damage.
old.name: Poison

lines: Deals poison damage over time and builds poisoning through its explicit ailment channel. Poison is its own damage type. Identical overlapping ground does not stack.
new.name: Poisoned Ground

lines: Lightning damage fills the shock gauge. When it fills, the target is shocked for 3 s: it takes more damage from every source and builds up stagger faster, both by the shock's strength. Strength depends on the lightning damage of the strongest hit in the build-up, before the target's defences, compared with the target's ailment threshold: a hit of 1% of it shocks for about 8%. Below 5% there is no shock, and it never goes above 50%. Shock effect makes it stronger, ailment duration makes it last longer. Only the strongest shock on a target acts, and a weaker one does not refresh it. Shock is not a stun and deals no damage itself.
new.name: Shock

lines: Lightning damage fills the shock gauge. Shock increases stagger build-up without dealing additional health damage; immediate stagger chance is a separate bonus.
old.name: Shock

lines: Deals lightning damage over time and builds shock. Shock strength uses the source potency, independent of tick frequency. Identical overlapping ground does not stack.
new.name: Shocked Ground

lines: A vertical melee weapon swing, primary or alternative. Horizontal swings and slams are not strikes, and a sceptre's strike is its Smite. Strike bonuses, strike copies and Critical Echo apply to these hits.
new.name: Strike

lines: A melee weapon swing: a horizontal or vertical attack of a melee weapon, primary or alternative. Slams are not strikes, and a sceptre's strike is its Smite. Strike bonuses, strike copies and Critical Echo apply to these hits.
old.name: Strike
